title: test(spec): pin SEARCH_AUTO_EXCLUDED_TYPES to every credential type in MASKED_ON_READ_FIELD_TYPES
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-tesla"} -->
_Requested by **Tesla** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao?thread=cmsg_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6JaoD992ixKFWg6AWFdAVqMbwG)_

Fixes #27822

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：在 `search-fields.test.ts` 加一条断言：`MASKED_ON_READ_FIELD_TYPES` 里的每个凭据类型（今天是 `secret`、`password`）都必须在 `SEARCH_AUTO_EXCLUDED_TYPES` 里。只改测试，不改任何发布代码。
- 为什么改：引擎、lint 判凭据类型读的是掩码表，而 REST 入口的 `$searchFields` 默认集读的是手写的排除集。以后有人往掩码表加新凭据类型却忘了排除集，REST 会放行引擎会扣下的字段；这条断言让那次修改当场变红。
- 风险与回滚：零运行时风险，发布值不变；回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/spec/src/data/search-fields.test.ts` 新增的 `SEARCH_AUTO_EXCLUDED_TYPES covers every credential type` 块。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/data/search-fields.test.ts`，预期 33/33 通过。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- One new `describe` in `packages/spec/src/data/search-fields.test.ts`: for every own key of `MASKED_ON_READ_FIELD_TYPES`, assert `SEARCH_AUTO_EXCLUDED_TYPES.has(key)` (one `it.each` row per credential type, with a message naming the type), plus a CONTROL that the table is non-empty so the pin cannot pass vacuously.
- Route: the pin, not the derivation. Deriving the set's credential members from the table would edit shipped source (`search-fields.ts`) and need a patch changeset; the triage record asks for a single assertion, and the pin closes the drift at the same edit.

## Tests

- Red first: injected a scratch key `textarea` into a local copy of `MASKED_ON_READ_FIELD_TYPES` (not committed; restored with `git checkout HEAD --`, hash matched the HEAD blob). `search-fields.test.ts` → `× credential type textarea is auto-excluded`, `Tests 1 failed | 32 passed (33)`, exit 1.
- Green at `799bb76f`: `search-fields.test.ts` + `masked-field-types.test.ts` → `Test Files 2 passed`, `Tests 43 passed`.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec test && pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec typecheck` under the verify lock → `VERDICT command-exit 0`; `Test Files 755 passed | 1 skipped (756)`, `Tests 22511 passed | 1 skipped | 1 todo`.

## Acceptance notes

- `skip-changeset`: the diff is a test file only. `@objectstack/spec`'s `files[]` ships `dist` and `src/**/*.zod.ts`; after a build the new test's describe string has 0 hits in `dist/`, while the positive control `SEARCH_AUTO_EXCLUDED_TYPES` hits `dist/browser/data/index.js`.
- The REST ingress itself (`assertSearchFieldsAreSearchable`) is unchanged; it still reads `SEARCH_AUTO_EXCLUDED_TYPES`, which this pin now holds to the credential vocabulary.

## Verification

<details><summary>Derived gates at 799bb76f (73 families)</summary>

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` → 73 commands; every line run with stdin from /dev/null, exit codes recorded before any pipe.
- 72 exit 0. Three first answered exit 3 (PREREQUISITE NOT MET) and were re-run after their prerequisite: `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` (after `git fetch --unshallow`), `@objectstack/lint check:doc-formula-expressions` and `check:lean-entry-closure` (after building the lint and objectql closures) → exit 0.
- NOT MEASURED: `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, reason: needs every workspace package built (89+ missing `dist/`); CI's `Lint & Repo Gates` runs it.
- `dispatch-gates.mjs --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack --ran` → `73 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 72 run, 1 NOT-MEASURED`.

</details>
